Guided jet ski tours near Fort De Soto Park

Fort De Soto Jet Ski Tours

Guided Yamaha WaveRunner rides minutes from Fort De Soto Park. Clear water, barrier islands, sandbars, Bunces Pass dolphins and the Sunshine Skyway on the horizon.

Check Availability Call (813) 538-4802

Why Fort De Soto

One of the best places in Florida to ride

Fort De Soto isn't just another beach. It's surrounded by barrier islands, sandbars, protected bays and wildlife habitat, with Gulf access and conditions that work for jet skiing almost year-round.

Every direction offers something worth seeing: wide-open riding, calm bays, beaches, historic landmarks, bird sanctuaries and some of the best views of the Sunshine Skyway you'll ever get.

Why guided?

Tampa Bay is big water with shallow grass flats, oyster bars, hidden sandbars, busy channels, protected areas and changing tides. Without local knowledge it's easy to get lost or run aground. Your guide handles all of that, so you just ride.

What you'll see

Where the ride goes

Every tour is a little different because wildlife, tides and weather change through the year. Depending on your tour length, you may visit:

Bunces Pass

A local favorite. Deep blue water, strong tidal flow, excellent dolphin activity and big scenery.

Shell Key Preserve

One of Florida's most beautiful undeveloped barrier islands, reachable only by boat. White sand, shelling and bird nesting areas.

Egmont Key

Longer tours head toward historic Egmont Key: lighthouse views, Fort Dade ruins, beaches, snorkeling and frequent dolphins.

Sunshine Skyway

Seeing one of Florida's most recognizable landmarks from the water is a completely different view than driving across it.

Wildlife

Dolphins are one of our biggest attractions

The waters around Fort De Soto have one of the healthiest populations of bottlenose dolphins in the Tampa Bay region, and we encounter them often. Watching them surface next to your WaveRunner is something you don't forget. Our guides always keep a respectful distance so the animals stay comfortable.

“Will we see dolphins?” We hear it every day. Wildlife is never guaranteed, but around Fort De Soto the odds are very good.

Who it's for

First ride or fiftieth

Beginners

Many guests have never driven a jet ski. You'll get a full orientation on controls, steering, safety, navigation rules and riding technique, and most riders are comfortable within minutes.

Experienced riders

Already own a ski? Ride some of the best water in Tampa Bay without trailering, launch logistics or route planning. Let someone else navigate while you enjoy it.

Families

Safe, scenic and beginner-friendly, with plenty of vacation photos. Kids can ride as passengers with a parent or guardian according to Florida safety rules.

When to go

Jet ski season lasts most of the year

Spring

Warm temperatures, clear water and comfortable weather. One of our favorite seasons.

Summer

Hot days and warm water. Morning rides usually get the calmest conditions before afternoon storms build.

Fall

Excellent weather, comfortable temperatures and less boat traffic.

Winter

Cooler water, but plenty of great riding days for visitors escaping colder states.

Fort De Soto FAQ

Before you go

All FAQs

Do I need a boating license to ride near Fort De Soto?

↓

Florida requires anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 to have a boater education card to operate a jet ski. The temporary card takes minutes online, and we're happy to answer questions before your reservation.

Can two people ride together?

↓

Yes. Our Yamaha WaveRunners comfortably carry two adults, up to 400 lb total, with no passenger fees.

What should I bring?

↓

Photo ID, swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, water shoes and a waterproof phone case for photos.

Are dolphin sightings guaranteed?

↓

Wildlife is never guaranteed, but dolphin encounters are very common around Fort De Soto.

Ride Fort De Soto with a local.

Pick your time online in a couple of minutes, or call (813) 538-4802 and we'll help you choose.
